title: sounds
prerequisites: Check v1.sounds supported, enabled, granted and ready; execute only with all required authorization.

operations.summary: Listen for any sounds: whether the phone tells you when the room gets loud (8.23)

The audio of a sound (up to 10 s, from just before it started), when the owner lets sounds send audio (kept in memory 10 minutes unless you chose longer with POST /v1/captures/storage; also GET /v1/captures/{id})

boundaries: Documented public API; owner switches, grants and runtime checks still apply.
